description: One item per room, every pair of neighbours related: SW-SE share the wall EV1, which has a door (connected); NW-NE share EV2, which has only a window (adjacent, not connected); SW-NW share EH1, which has an empty, cased opening (connected); SE-NE share the separator EH2 (connected). NE-SW meet only at a junction: neither adjacent nor connected.
